faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for ICAR-CAZRI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 13 November 2026, and candidates report at 11:00 AM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in ICAR-CAZRI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Young Professional-I (YP-I).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for ICAR-CAZRI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 13 November 2026 at 11:00 AM. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. Where is the walk-in interview for this recruitment?
faq.answer: ICAR-CAZRI, Kukma-Bhuj.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is up to 45 years for both men and women.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 30,000 per month + HRA.

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Postgraduate degree in an agricultural discipline (Agronomy, Soil Science, Plant Protection, Horticulture and Allied Sciences) with at least five years of research/field/laboratory work experience in any ICAR institute/SAU/KVK/research institute; good working knowledge of computers, data analysis and fieldwork.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Good working knowledge of computers, data analysis and fieldwork.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Engagement on a purely temporary basis. For the duration of the project (two years), as per the project guidelines.
